chunks: And from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

A servant may have a status with his Lord that he cannot attain by his actions; therefore, he is tried in his body, or afflicted in his wealth, or afflicted in his children. And if he is patient, Allah will bring him to that status.

key_terms.بَلَّغَهُ: He brought him to / attained for him

ai.seo_question: How do trials and afflictions help a believer attain spiritual ranks they cannot reach through good deeds alone?
ai.summary: The Imam explains that a believer may possess a high spiritual rank that their deeds alone cannot secure. To bridge this gap, Allah tests them through afflictions in their body, wealth, or children; if they respond with patience, these trials elevate them to the destined status.
